messages:
Olivia: Quick heads-up — planning to enable flash-attn v2 for small/med models in the us-west canary tomorrow 09:30 PT. Goal: latency win without regressing generation quality. Anyone object or have blockers?

Mike: quick Q — does flash-attn touch KV cache layout? we had strange cache hit rates last week after a kernel flip.

Sara: It shouldn't change the KV layout itself, but combined with speculative_decoding it can amplify token duplication for some fp16 quantized variants. recommend not enabling speculative_decode in the same canary.

Ben: +1 to Sara. Also propose staged rollout: 5% (internal clients + infra tests) -> 20% -> 100. auto-rollback if generation-divergence > 0.8% or p99 latency +20ms.

Olivia: Proposed rollout config (draft):
```yaml
feature: runtime.flash_attn_v2
enabled: true
canary:
  pct: 5
  audience: [internal, infra-tests]
  regions: [us-west-2]
  block_if: 
    - metric: gen_divergence
      op: ">"
      value: 0.8
    - metric: p99_latency
      op: ">"
      value: 20ms
fallback: runtime.flash_attn_v1
controls:
  allow_speculative_decode: false
  kv_cache_mode: conservative
```
Please review guardrails and names.

Mike: That looks good. Suggest adding a temporary KV cache bypass for models with context_len < 128 to reduce risk: `kv_cache_mode_override: small_context_bypass`.

Carla: Pinging @Eng-SRE for infra constraints — we need capacity reserved for rollback path (GPU pool cold-start time ~3m).

infra-bot: scheduled_canary: 2026-03-18T16:30:00Z, id=canary-20260318-01.

Eng-SRE: noted. We can reserve a 2x standby pool for the canary window. Question: does the runtime support dynamic kernel toggle without process restart? if not we need a shorter canary and smoke restart playbook.

Dave: code review ping to Olivia — PR 4789 updates kernel selection + rollout checks. linked: https://git.company/repo/pull/4789. reviewers: @Mike @Sara @Ben.

Ben: Also let's add an automated nightly eval: sample 1k prompts from production (anonymized) and compare top-1 token divergence. Fail the canary if divergence > 0.5% across samples.

Sara: FYI I ran a quick local with spec_decode=true + flash-attn and saw duplicate tokens on llama-small-4q. Will post snippet in the PR. For canary we should explicitly set `allow_speculative_decode=false` (Olivia's config already does).

Olivia: Thanks — I'll open a short RFC and the rollout PR now, include the KV bypass and nightly eval. tagging reviewers. If no objections by EOD I'll schedule the 09:30 PT canary. :thumbsup:

Mike: one last ask — add a config flag to limit kernel fallthroughs per request (e.g., max_kernel_switches: 1). prevents flip-flopping in path selection.

Olivia: good call, adding `max_kernel_switches: 1` to rollout config. will update PR.

infra-bot: canary-20260318-01 status: queued. will post start/finish in thread.

Carla: Thanks all — will monitor dashboards during canary window.

Olivia: Great. will post PR link here when ready, and include a brief rollback playbook.
